description: First Treet Manufacturing Modaraba is a multipurpose, perpetual Modaraba formed under the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 on 27 July 2005 and managed by Treet Holdings Limited. Its registered office is at 72-B, Industrial Area, Kot Lakhpat, Lahore, and it is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. The Modaraba manufactures and sells corrugated boxes and soaps, and its site also lists a battery project at Faisalabad Industrial City and a Treet Bikes unit at its Lahore premises.
